Before dismantling the assembly, check that the shock absorber slides freely along the guides of tool 1.874.555.000. Do not, under any circumstances, use any tools for leverage to try and facilitate the extraction of the spring.

1. If there are any faults in the shock absorber, it should be replaced in one piece.

2. Make sure that the coil spring does not show signs of cracks or distortion that could adversely effect its operation. The coil springs are divided into two categories, identifiable by a stripe of white paint (10 q - 14 q) or blue paint (maxi). Springs with the same colour markings must be fitted.

3. Check the condition of the other shock absorber components:

- coil spring cover (3a);

- mounting (3b) fixing shock absorber to bodyshell;

- seal (3c);

- nut (3d) fixing shock absorber to mounting.
